title: Domino's Pizza USA
description:
Get more of what you love—right here in the Domino’s app. Build your perfect pizza, or pick a specialty pizza, then pick your favorite sides, drinks and desserts. Choose delivery or carryout, and join Domino’s Rewards to earn points you can redeem for more of your favorites. Track every update with the Domino’s Tracker.
 
Use the Domino’s Pizza app to order from restaurants in the United States, not including Puerto Rico. To place an order in Puerto Rico, visit www.DominosPR.com.

FEATURES: 

• Faster, easier ordering
• Deals & Rewards
• Order tracking

APP PERMISSIONS: 
Location 
Precise location/GPS – identifies your closest restaurants for easier carryout ordering

Phone
Directly call phone numbers – makes it possible for you to call your local restaurant with a single tap within the app

Camera
Take pictures and videos – used to quickly capture debit or credit card information at checkout

Photos/Media/Files
USB Storage – required for upgraded Google Maps

Microphone
Record audio – needed to enable Dom, our voice ordering assistant

Bluetooth connection information
Needed for integration with Ford Sync, Android Wear and Pebble watch

Device ID & call information
Read phone status and identity – required as part of the Ford Sync feature, this is used if you want to call your store through Sync while your phone screen is locked


Other

• Full network access – this allows us to communicate with the Domino’s systems to provide you with the latest restaurant menus and coupons and it is needed to place orders from the app

• View network connections - required by Google Maps, which we use to show store locations

• Network communication - enables push notifications, giving you access to app exclusives, coupons and deals

• Control vibration – helps alert you to updates, like changes in order status as it progresses through the Tracker

• Prevent phone from sleeping – if you are using your voice to order, the app will prevent the phone from going to sleep (which would otherwise happen because you aren’t tapping the phone)

title: Domino Dreams™
description:
✨ Domino Dreams - Relax, Match & Discover the Joy of Domino Games! Welcome to Domino Dreams, where relaxing domino games meet colorful design, satisfying puzzles, and endless fun. This is your place to unwind, play, and enjoy the most beautiful domino game experience ever created.
Step into a dreamy world filled with soothing board game adventures, where every match brings excitement, rewards, and pure satisfaction. Whether you’re a long-time fan of dominoes or new to the domino game, you’ll love the simple joy of matching tiles, earning coins, and solving delightful puzzles.

🌸 Relax, Match & Play
 Play through thousands of amazing domino games that blend strategy, creativity, and relaxation. Use your tiles wisely to solve each puzzle, collect coins, and unlock new levels. Each domino game is designed to help you relax and challenge your mind at the same time — the perfect arcade experience for any mood.

✨ Domino Dreams Features:
Enjoy a fresh twist on classic dominoes with relaxing gameplay, satisfying matches, and colorful boards.

Collect coins, boosters, and rewards as you progress through hundreds of beautiful domino puzzles.

Experience smooth and calming arcade action that keeps you entertained for hours.

Explore countless domino games with unique challenges and creative tile layouts.

Discover new puzzles, unlock streak bonuses, and use coins to enhance your gaming experience.

Play anytime, anywhere — Domino Dreams is the perfect board game to unwind and have fun.

Every move in this domino game brings a little spark of joy. Watch the tiles fall perfectly into place, complete clever puzzles, and earn satisfying coins for your achievements. Each new domino level opens the door to more creativity, color, and calm.

🏆 Enjoy the Journey
 Challenge your skills and master your favorite domino games. With every level, you’ll solve classic puzzles and experience the simple pleasure of collecting coins and completing beautiful boards. The combination of relaxing play, rewarding goals, and charming design makes Domino Dreams an unforgettable arcade adventure.

🌷 Your Everyday Escape
 When life gets busy, take a break and dive into the peaceful world of Domino Dreams. These soothing domino games will help you relax, focus, and recharge — one puzzle at a time. Watch your coins grow as you progress through creative board game levels, each filled with surprises and delightful moments.

Let yourself drift into the dreamlike rhythm of Domino Dreams — the ultimate domino game for anyone who loves matching, solving, and collecting. Download today and discover why millions of players are falling in love with the world’s most enchanting domino games! 🌟

🎯 Follow Domino Dreams on Facebook for exclusive offers and bonuses!
 https://www.facebook.com/DominoDreams/

🎯 Having problems? Please contact us via email at domino-help@superplay.co

Domino Dreams™ is intended for those 18 and older. Domino Dreams™ does not require payment to download and play, but it also allows you to purchase virtual items with real money inside the game, including random items. You can disable in-app purchases in your device’s settings. Domino Dreams™ may also contain advertising.
You may require an internet connection to play Domino Dreams™ and access its social features. You can also find more information about functionality, compatibility, and interoperability in the app store listing.

title: Classic Dominoes: Dominos Game
description:
Experience one of the most relaxing and strategic classic Dominoes games on mobile — perfect for offline play and enjoyable for players of all ages, especially seniors, adults, and classic domino fans.

🎲 Classic Dominoes: Dominos Game is a free-to-play domino board game. Detailed tutorials make it easy for beginners to learn, while still offering rewarding gameplay for experienced players. Enjoy an intuitive interface, easy controls, easy-to-read tile faces, and smooth gameplay on both phones and tablets.

Whether you enjoy the familiar rhythm of classic domino gameplay or are interested in styles related to Straight Domino, Chicken Foot, or All Fives Domino, Classic Dominoes: Dominos Game delivers a satisfying and authentic tile-based experience.

🕹️ How to Play:

• Match the Pips: Place a domino with matching numbers at one end of the chain. Be the first to play all your dominoes to win the round.
• 3 Classic Domino Modes:
  - Draw Dominoes: No playable tile? Draw from the boneyard until you can make a move.
  - Block Dominoes: No drawing allowed. If you can't play, you skip your turn.
  - Dominoes All Fives: Score points when the sum of the open ends equals 5 or a multiple of 5. Use unlimited hints to quickly check the total.
• Win the Game: Points are counted after each round. The first player to reach the victory score wins!

⭐ Key Features:

• Offline Play – No wifi needed, no waiting for other players, and no pressure from live competition. Perfect for travel, breaks, or relaxing at home.
• 3 Classic Domino Modes – Enjoy Draw, Block, and All Fives Dominoes in one app. Each mode offers its own rules and strategic style.
• Smart AI Opponents – Play 1v1 against a single AI opponent or enjoy a 4-player match against 3 AI rivals. Perfect for practicing or relaxing at your own pace.
• Intuitive Interface & Easy Controls – Play with a clean, user-friendly layout designed for smooth, comfortable gameplay on phones and tablets.
• Leaderboards & Rank Progression – Track your stats, climb the ranks, and rise from novice to elite.
• Daily Tasks & Star Tournament – Complete daily tasks to earn coins. Join the limited‑time Star Tournament to collect stars and earn extra rewards.
• Customization Options – Personalize your domino experience with beautifully designed avatars, boards, and stylish tile sets.
• Stunning Visuals & Sound – Enjoy polished visuals and satisfying sound effects that make every match more immersive and fun.
• Multilingual Interface – Use multiple language options for a more accessible and comfortable domino board game experience.

💡 Perfect for Fans of:

• Enjoying relaxing gameplay with a touch of strategic challenge
• Sharpening your mind with classic domino strategy
• Unwinding anytime with smooth, stress‑free matches
• Playing against smart AI at your own pace

Ready to relax, think ahead, and rise from beginner to master?

🎉 Download Classic Dominoes: Dominos Game now and start your classic domino journey today. Share the fun with friends, recommend the game, and show off your progress along the way.

💌 Feedback Matters! If you have any questions or suggestions, feel free to contact us at android.joypiece@gmail.com. We're committed to creating the best possible experience, and your feedback is invaluable!

title: KOGA Domino - Classic Dominoes
description:
Dominoes is an old game, easy to learn and one of the most popular in the world. KOGA Domino brings this classic to your phone, bringing the same experience and sensations of real life to your screen.

Wonderful, optimized and dynamic graphic design, for you to have a lot of fun with friends and your family.

The new version adopts the same rules as the World Domino Championship organized by the International Domino Federation (FID), thus allowing you to experience the charm of dominoes on your mobile phone, with fair and clear rules.

Game Modes:

1. Championship mode: The rules of the world championship, which is played in pairs, are adopted. In real time, with players from all over the world, you can participate in the global ranking and win many coins/rewards and get the prize as the best in the world in the season

2. Quick mode: Played with 2, 3 or 4 players, you don't have to wait for the table to be filled, each game lasts up to 2 minutes, great way to be played on your little breaks throughout the day.

3. Points mode: Appropriate mode so that you are attentive and full of skill, you have a chance to win many coins, here the bet is high.

4. Computer mode: Are you on the plane, on the road and without internet? No problem, you can play offline.

5. In all rooms we have many animated stickers for you to interact with your game mates, to make your game more fun and iterative. Whether give them a it's a slipper or a shower of rose petals, you choose.
